title: Answering your questions on rural life
en: hello everyone i hope you're having a lovely day this has not been the easiest year especially for my country and in the midst of the current turmoil i'm reaching out to you and hoping that together we can find a moment of peace enjoying nature and all the abundance it gives us as you can see that early snowfall melted away as quickly as it came but it will be back in this video i will be answering a few more questions on rural cottage living since my channel has grown and i've received many more inquiries on what it's like to live out here

one question i'm often asked is for advice on how to make the move to the countryside and how exactly i did it myself but i don't really know how to answer these questions because i don't really feel like an expert and my story is so different from yours that there is little advice i could give that would apply to everyone's different situations all i will say is that anything is possible with patience and perseverance don't give yourself a timeline on when to achieve a dream work towards it one tiny step at a time it may take years or even decades and some creative thinking but it can happen the people who live in my area come from a variety of financial and social backgrounds some like myself rent tiny homes others live off-grid in

order to be able to afford land i suppose the options are as limited or varied as you decide they are but most importantly my mission with these videos is to highlight the magic in daily life in a way that can be applied wherever you are not just the countryside for me my environment is a great benefit to my soul but not the foundation of my joy i had to work on myself and my spirituality to find contentment another question i often get is about

isolation wild animals and strangers for privacy reasons i don't wish to film the other homes in my area but i'm not alone in the wilderness per se and i have several neighbors within walking distance i need to drive about five miles to get to my job and i feel both remote yet able to access what i need in town when i visit as for dealing with animals in such a rural place predators are very wary of humans and it is rare that they would show themselves even more so that they would ever attack the number of incidents every year is very low and i personally believe that by choosing to live in a rural place it's my responsibility to respect the animals that live here since they are the ones that are most often attacked by us and whose homes are taken away on a

related note some people have expressed fear of running into dangerous strangers walking the wilderness and i'd say that if you find anyone here at all it's probably a friendly hiker or a local and it feels extremely safe lastly to those who have inquired about me on a personal level i realized i've never actually spoken my name here it is paola and i'm turning 24 this december my boyfriend's name is luke and you will no doubt meet him in a future video i have two siblings who live and thrive in cities a sister named lyanna and my brother rohan
who lives in australia i hope you can meet them someday they're one of my greatest sources of pride and joy and love i hope this at least answered some of

your questions and feel free to ask me more as usual i've left all relevant links to information in the description bar that being said i will now invite you to come with me to a canyon near my home to take a deep breath of crisp autumn air to smell the pines and what earth and let all your worries and fears of the future to wash away with the raindrops no matter what happens externally you have the power to cultivate contentment and peace at this time in the world things may seem polarized and angry and confusing but there is always hope and everywhere there are good people doing good things it's just a matter of where you look i'm sending you all my love and encouragement on your own journey
comment and let me know how you're doing i always love reading your messages have a lovely day or night you
zh: 大家好，我希望你们度过了愉快的一天，这对我的国家来说并不是最轻松的一年，在当前的动荡中，我向你们伸出援手，希望我们能够一起找到一个和平的时刻，享受大自然和它给我们的所有丰富，因为你们可以看到早期的降雪很快就融化了，但它会在这个视频中回归，自从我的频道发展以来，我将回答更多关于乡村小屋生活的问题，我收到了更多关于它是什么的询问喜欢住在这里

我经常被问到的一个问题是如何搬到乡村以及我自己到底是如何做到的，但我真的不知道如何回答这些问题，因为我真的不觉得自己像专家，而且我的故事与你的故事如此不同，以至于我无法提供适用于每个人不同情况的建议，我要说的是，只要有耐心和毅力，一切皆有可能，不要给自己一个时间表，告诉自己何时实现梦想，一次一小步，可能需要数年或数年的时间甚至几十年和一些创造性思维，但这可能会发生 住在我所在地区的人来自不同的经济和社会背景 有些人像我一样租用小房子 其他人住在离网的地方
为了能够买得起土地，我想选择是有限的还是多种多样的，取决于你的决定，但最重要的是，我的这些视频的使命是强调日常生活中的魔力，无论你在哪里，都可以应用，对我来说，不仅仅是乡村，我的环境对我的灵魂有很大的好处，但不是我快乐的基础，我必须在自己和灵性上努力才能找到满足感，我经常遇到的另一个问题是关于

出于隐私原因，我不想拍摄我所在地区的其他房屋，但我本身在荒野中并不孤单，我有几个邻居在步行距离之内，我需要开车大约五英里才能到达我的工作地点，我感觉既遥远又能够在访问时获得我在城里需要的东西至于在这样的农村地区处理动物，掠食者对人类非常警惕，而且很少会表现得更加严重，因此每年发生的事件数量非常多低，我个人认为，选择生活在农村地区，我有责任尊重生活在这里的动物，因为它们是最常受到我们攻击的动物，它们的家园被强行夺走。
相关说明有些人表示害怕在荒野中遇到危险的陌生人，我想说的是，如果你在这里找到任何人，那可能是一个友好的徒步旅行者或当地人，对于那些在个人层面上询问过我的人来说，感觉非常安全。最后，我意识到我从来没有真正在这里说过我的名字，我是保拉，今年 12 月我就满 24 岁了，我男朋友的名字是卢克，你毫无疑问会在未来的视频中见到他我有两个生活和繁荣的兄弟姐妹在城市里，有一位名叫莱安娜的姐妹和我的兄弟罗汉
谁住在澳大利亚，我希望有一天你能见到他们，他们是我骄傲、快乐和爱的最大来源之一，我希望这至少回答了一些问题

你的问题，请像往常一样随意问我，我已经在描述栏中留下了所有相关信息的链接，话虽这么说，我现在邀请你和我一起去我家附近的一个峡谷，深吸一口秋日的清新空气，闻松树和泥土的味道，让你对未来的所有担忧和恐惧随着雨滴一起冲走，无论外部发生什么，你有能力培养满足与和平，在这个世界上，事情可能看起来两极分化、愤怒和混乱，但总有希望，无处不在有好人在做好事，这只是你看向哪里的问题，我在你自己的旅程中向你发送我所有的爱和鼓励
评论并让我知道你过得怎么样我总是喜欢阅读你的消息祝你度过愉快的一天或夜晚
